Trusted by

Truly understand your agents

Adaline ingests production traces and groups recurring agent patterns into behavior maps your team can inspect.

Evals that write themselves

Adaline generates evals from detected behaviors and user feedback, so regressions are caught before agent changes ship.

From edge cases to test data

Adaline generates production-faithful synthetic data for the scenarios you keep meaning to cover and the ones you never knew existed.

Agents auto-improve while you sleep

Adaline is the ML layer between your traces and your agent diffs — behaviors, evals, data. Cursor and Claude are the “make no mistake” guesses; this is the feedback loop grounded in real signals.
